title: 'We owe them our solidarity': Rahul writes to ally Soren over student protests

Gandhi emphasized that the Congress party stands in complete solidarity with the students, voicing concerns over the exploitation of the Indian education system by certain factions.

title: 2 more Air India pilots fail to clear dope test after Phuket-Delhi flight scare
content: Air India's recent pilot screening revealed two non-negative dope test results, leading to these pilots being grounded while awaiting confirmatory tests. In response, the aviation ministry has instructed the DGCA to revise current dope testing protocols. The intended policy overhaul aims to impose stricter penalties for pilots found using illegal drugs, while also distinguishing between accidental use of medication and intentional substance abuse.

title: Hours after CJP's school inspection call, Rajasthan bars outsiders from campuses
content: Rajasthan's education department has restricted outsider entry into schools without principal permission. This directive follows the Cockroach Janta Party's announcement of a statewide campaign. The CJP plans to inspect dilapidated government schools across nine districts over two weeks. Volunteers will raise student issues as the administration has ignored repair demands. The group warns of a movement if a plan for classroom repairs is not presented.

title: ChatGPT gave Google ‘Code Red’; now OpenAI’s Greg Brockman faces ‘Red Flag’

With the resignation of Chief Revenue Officer Denise Dresser and COO Brad Lightcap, experts are voicing worries about the potential impact on the company's internal dynamics. In response, co-founder Greg Brockman is ramping up his efforts to stabilize operations during this transitional period.

title: MacKenzie Scott helped abolish $40bn in medical debt; how mechanics work
content: MacKenzie Scott's philanthropic efforts have made a significant impact by enabling the cancellation of medical debt across the United States. By purchasing and eliminating patient debt at a minimal cost, she has set a precedent that encourages other wealthy individuals to invest in similar initiatives. Despite these immediate acts of generosity, the need for comprehensive policy reforms persists, as true transformation necessitates addressing the fundamental issues leading to medical debt.

title: California startup's $3 billion 'manta ray' jet promises 50% lower fuel use
content: JetZero is unveiling a cutting-edge 'manta ray' aircraft aimed at revolutionizing the future of commercial aviation. This groundbreaking design is expected to yield impressive fuel savings and significantly lower emissions. With a full-scale prototype scheduled to take flight by 2027, Japan Airlines is on board to provide operational insights, paving the way for expected commercial operations in the early 2030s.

title: New Zealand teacher and students turn coastal paddock into native habitat
content: Retired teacher Janet Pottinger spent 29 years helping Buller High School students restore native vegetation at Tauranga Bay and Cape Foulwind in New Zealand. Since 1997, around 2,800 students have planted 12,425 native plants across 108 trips. The project has transformed former grassland into habitat supporting birds, seals, lizards and other native wildlife.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes a 'vacation request' to employees for this month
content: Accenture's CEO, Julie Sweet, has requested that employees delay their vacation in August. This temporary policy adjustment is designed to bolster staff presence as the company approaches the end of its financial year. Following disappointing quarterly results and a forecasted drop in revenue, Accenture is permitting employees to carry over unused vacation days into the next fiscal year to help enhance fourth-quarter outputs and revenue generation.

title: Apple told to pay Rs 45,500 to customer after iPhone overheats, faces network issues
content: A Haryana consumer commission ordered Apple India to refund Rs 45,500 for a defective iPhone 15.  The customer complained about repeated overheating and connectivity issues with the device.  Apple claimed unauthorized modifications, but the commission found no proof of tampering.  The company also must pay Rs 10,000 for compensation and costs.  The ruling highlights Apple's liability for service deficiencies during warranty.

title: 300 guards jump in unison to test Mahakaleshwar temple bridge before Nag Panchami
content: Over 300 security guards performed a load test on a new foot overbridge.  Engineers inspected the bridge for structural integrity and signs of corrosion.  The 91-foot-long bridge will carry thousands of devotees to the Nagchandreshwar temple.  Authorities recommend a maximum of 300 devotees use the bridge simultaneously.  The bridge was constructed in 2022 and passed its recent safety inspection.

title: Gold price prediction today: Will gold prices continue to rally?

title: BWF Worlds day 1: PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty among Indians in action; full schedule

title: Bengal hotel fire: 7 charred to death in Birbhum, several critically injured
content: A massive fire erupted at Hotel Bideshinii in Tarapith early Monday morning. Five guests were killed and several others critically injured in the devastating blaze. The fire quickly engulfed the hotel, trapping many guests who were asleep. Firefighters rushed to the scene and brought the flames under control. Injured individuals were transported to Rampurhat Government Medical College and Hospital.

title: Noida biker at 80kmph dies after Chinese manjha slits his throat
content: A delivery agent died after a Chinese manjha slit his throat on the expressway. The synthetic kite string caused fatal bleeding while the bike traveled at high speed. Police have arrested several individuals for selling the banned Chinese manjha. Authorities are checking kite shops to enforce the prohibition on its sale. This incident renews concerns over the dangerous and illegal trade of the string.

title: Trump clears foreign shipyards to build US warships - what it means for India
content: The United States has opened its naval shipbuilding to foreign yards. This new policy allows overseas shipbuilders to construct US Navy vessels. Indian shipyards may now be considered for this significant construction work. Foreign builders must establish or invest in US shipyards. This initiative aims to expand American naval capacity and workforce.

title: Vande Mataram 'disruption' row: Delhi Police probes complaint against Sonia, Rahul
content: The Delhi Police have launched an investigation into a complaint against Sonia and Rahul Gandhi, alleging that they disrupted the singing of Vande Mataram at an Independence Day celebration. Advocates supporting the complaint have referenced video evidence and media reports documenting the incident. Currently, the police are scrutinizing alleged gestures and remarks made during this national song, and an FIR has yet to be filed as the inquiry continues.

title: Nurse leaves bedridden woman unattended, consumer commission orders agency to pay Rs 24K
content: A Kerala consumer commission found a nursing agency deficient in service.  The agency failed to provide a replacement nurse for a bedridden elderly woman.  This abrupt discontinuation of care caused significant distress and inconvenience to the patient.  The commission ordered the agency to refund charges and pay compensation for the lapse.  The agency must now pay Rs 4,000 refund and Rs 15,000 compensation.

title: Rupee falls 17 paise against US dollar as FCNR swap deadline weighs down sentiment
content: The Indian rupee fell against the US dollar at the start of Monday, influenced by the Reserve Bank of India's move to advance a deposit swap deadline. While the bank had previously drawn in substantial foreign currency, analysts predict temporary support for the rupee, though overall weakness is expected. Additionally, domestic stock markets recorded a drop early in the trading session.

After years of success in tennis, the birth of Alexander made her see happiness differently. Her three sons became her greatest pride, and Evert has continued to describe being their mother as the most meaningful part of her life.

Customers are encouraged to verify the specific holiday hours pertinent to their state before heading to a branch. Key closures include August 25 and 26 for Milad-Un-Nabi and Thiruvonam, with an additional break on August 28 for Raksha Bandhan and other local celebrations. title: Never accepted Nalsar invitation, so no question of going: CJI
content: chief justice of india has not accepted invitation to be chief guest at convocation . a section of students opposing his presence at the convocation snowballed after bar Council of India jumped in and ordered blackballing of the graduates before retracting with regret .

title: US backs 'Islamic Nato': Trump calls Saudi-Turkey-Pak pact 'big, bold step'
content: the pact has brought the three major Islamic nations closer on defence . it has already drawn comparisons with Nato's collective defence principle . the resemblance to the principle has earned the grouping the moniker "Islamic Nato"

title: Europe wildfires: 2 dead, 500 evacuated as twin blazes hit Greek island near Athens
content: two people have died in two wildfires that broke out simultaneously on the island of Salamis near athens . the emergency began at 2.40pm local time in peristeria, where strong winds pushed flames through a wooded residential area . about 500 people were evacuated by sea as crews raced to prevent the fires from joining .

title: 'Modi ji, look at what your NTA has done': Rahul after agency admits errors
content: Rahul Gandhi criticizes the government and the national testing agency . he says the exams were cancelled nearly two months after they were conducted . thousands of candidates who prepared for the exams, paid application fees and travelled to examination centres will have to appear again in September .

title: 'Warm goodbye to the party I love': Shehzad Poonawalla resigns from BJP 'once again'
content: shehzad Poonawalla resubmits his resignation from all party posts . he says he "bids a warm goodbye" to BJP president Nitin Nabin . in a post on X, he said he had "once again submitted" his resignation letter .

title: 'I’m an actor, I earn from it': Ajay on elaichi row, SRK on controversial ads
content: ajay Devgn's old remarks defending his decision to appear in a popular elaichi advertisement have resurfaced following the fda's latest action against the brand's celebrity endorsers . the ad could amount to surrogate promotion of Vimal Pan Masala, which is banned in Maharashtra .

title: 7 killed, several injured in stampede-like incident at Bihar’s Lakhisarai temple
content: the incident took place as a large crowd had gathered at the temple, officials say . it also took place on Shravan’s Somvaar, a day traditionally draws devotees to Shiva temples .

title: 'Not worthy of life': Israel calls for killing '30 to 40' people daily in Gaza
content: itamar Ben-Gvir, a lawmaker in prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition, publicly called for the killing of “30 to 40” people in Gaza each night . he said targeted assassinations should be carried out in Gaza, taking down 30 to 40 people every night, not just those who pose an immediate threat .

title: Iran offers $30,000 bounty for killing, capturing US soldiers; $60,000 if done by women
content: the reward doubles to $60,000 if the act is carried out by an Iranian woman . the announcement comes amid ongoing tensions between Tehran and Washington . there is no known deployment of US ground troops inside Iran . amir Hatami says the plan was drawn up following "the large number of requests"

title: Disproportionate assets case: SC asks Allahabad HC not to proceed against Rahul
content: the apex court asked the Allahabad high court not to proceed with case against Rahul Gandhi . the top court also directed the CBI and Enforcement Directorate not to submit any probe report to any authority . if the complainant’s allegations were found to be true, the matter would amount to a “gross disproportionate assets case”

title: Prashant Kishor takes oath as Bankipur MLA after first Jan Suraaj victory
content: Jan Suraaj Party founder Prashant Kishor took oath as the bankipur MLA . he said he would seek to follow the example of 'hundreds of MLAs who dedicated the valuable years of their lives to the betterment of society and the state'

title: ‘Very good’ ties with Kim: Trump orders 'substantial' cut in military drills with South Korea
content: u.s. president Donald Trump has ordered the Pentagon to reduce planned joint military exercises . he said the exercises would send an inappropriate and hostile signal to north Korea . the exercises are scheduled to begin this week, citing his "very good relationship" with north Korean leader .

title: Lakshmi Mittal's Ukraine steel plant hit by Russian missile; 2 killed
content: the missile strike hit the arcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih mining and metallurgical plant . two people were killed and over 10 workers were injured, the company says . the strike also caused casualties and damage elsewhere in Ukraine .
